name: Environment
description: Isolated pak/renv plans, realizations, explicit verification and original-operation native recovery

capabilities.title: Observe Environment activity
capabilities.description: Observe configured activity or qualify explicit work without starting R or installing packages.

capabilities.title: Inspect Environment inventory
capabilities.description: Read cached native configuration and bounded DESCRIPTION metadata. Requires an authorized successful source for a selected realization; never launch R, load packages or recover native work.

EnvironmentObservation.description:
Native configuration is established during explicit Host startup or an
Environment operation. Reading it never starts R or tests namespace loading.

pak_available.description: Cached startup/operation probe, not a current loadability guarantee.

renv_available.description: Cached startup/operation probe, not a current loadability guarantee.

capabilities.title: Plan an isolated Environment
capabilities.description: Create an immutable native pak/renv plan in isolated material storage. Preserve the complete result as an original-operation resource; do not install into user libraries.

verified.description: None for planning/configuration; false never means successful verification.

capabilities.title: Prepare: Plan an isolated Environment
capabilities.description: Observe configured activity or qualify explicit work without starting R or installing packages.

capabilities.title: Realize an isolated Environment
capabilities.description: Resolve an authorized successful plan and realize it in an isolated library. Verify native source and lockfile digests; do not change existing R sessions.

verified.description: None for planning/configuration; false never means successful verification.

capabilities.title: Prepare: Realize an isolated Environment
capabilities.description: Observe configured activity or qualify explicit work without starting R or installing packages.

capabilities.title: Verify a realized Environment
capabilities.description: Explicitly verify one authorized realization using native namespace probes and library digests. Preserve the complete original report.

verified.description: None for planning/configuration; false never means successful verification.

capabilities.title: Prepare: Verify a realized Environment
capabilities.description: Observe configured activity or qualify explicit work without starting R or installing packages.

capabilities.title: Reconcile original Environment work
capabilities.description: Inspect and clean up the native process tree of one terminal original Environment operation. Keep its records and staged files; never repeat the installation.

verified.description: None for planning/configuration; false never means successful verification.

capabilities.title: Prepare: Reconcile original Environment work
capabilities.description: Observe configured activity or qualify explicit work without starting R or installing packages.

capabilities.title: Observe native Environment configuration
capabilities.description: Explicitly establish native R configuration for later read-only inventory queries. This operation may launch R; observation and activation do not.

verified.description: None for planning/configuration; false never means successful verification.

capabilities.title: Prepare: Observe native Environment configuration
capabilities.description: Observe configured activity or qualify explicit work without starting R or installing packages.

rscript.description: An explicit installed executable; activation never discovers or installs R.

storage_root.description:
Reopen an existing material directory after its previous owner has exited.
None uses this instance's Host-provided data directory.
